request.system:
You extract one experience card from a finished customer-support chat.

Return ONLY a JSON object with these keys:
  problem_shape   string, ≤12 words, lowercase, the kind of request
  constraint      string, ≤12 words, what blocked progress, or "none"
  unlock          string, ≤12 words, the move that unblocked it, or "none"
  what_worked     array of 1-8 short step names
  contains_pii    boolean

Rules:
- Never copy customer names, emails, phones, addresses, payment numbers,
  or raw order/account identifiers into any field. Replace them with a
  generic token ("order id", "account", "photo").
- If you had to strip an identifier, set contains_pii=true. That flag does
  NOT discard the card. It only marks that a scrub happened.
- Prefer the customer's wording for problem_shape.
- constraint is the policy, missing data, or system limit that stalled the chat.
- unlock is the turning point, not a summary of the whole chat.
- If nothing useful happened, use "none" and a short what_worked anyway.
- No markdown. No extra keys. No commentary.
request.user:
Scope: abcd-single_item_query/customer-support
Channel: web

Transcript:
agent: AcmeBrands, how may I help you?
customer: Yes i was looking at one of your items that i'm thinking about buying. But i do have some question i'm hoping you can help me with first before i do.
agent: Sure, what question can I answer for you?
customer: The item i was looking at is the Calvin Klein boots in brown
customer: My question is are these boots waterproof?
agent: Let me find out for you.
tool: Searching the FAQ pages ...
tool: System Action: search boots
agent: Most of our boots are waterproof but we do have some that are not.
agent: The way to find out is the guarantee that is attached upon purchase.
customer: it no way that you could see if they are waterproof?
agent: Not until you buy them
agent: However if you find out that they are not waterproof, you can always return them
customer: I really would like to know before i buy them. usually the people are able to get the answer for me.
agent: Well there is no way to now because it depends on the different designs for each season, so it will change from time to time.
customer: okay
agent: I apologize for not being able to help you out.
agent: Can I help you with anything else?
customer: That okay, that will be all
agent: Have a good day.
customer: you too
